name: Isthmian Games
summary: Poseidon's biennial crown games on the Corinthian Isthmus — pine, later wild celery, for the victors — instituted, the poets say, by Sisyphus over the drowned child Melicertes, renamed Palaemon.
testimonia: Apollodorus, Bibliotheca 3.4.3 (Sisyphus institutes the Isthmian games for Melicertes)
Pausanias 2.1.3 (the boy brought ashore by a dolphin; the games on the Isthmus)
Hyginus, Fabulae 2 (contests every fifth year for Palaemon)
Calendar note: no baked Isthmian peak yet — Olympics alone use olympicPeak in the Attic reconstruction; Isthmia still awaits its own cycle anchor (not faked with annual conventionalDates)
